description: FU Berlin's central, data-protection-compliant AI chatbot for teaching and learning, with access to Azure-hosted OpenAI models and GWDG/KISSKI open-weight models.
howToObtain: Sign in using FU Account single sign-on.
costToUser: No cost for FU members until further notice.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Freie Universität Berlin's official KI.Assist@FU page calls it the University's central, data-protection-compliant AI chatbot for teaching and learning. Teachers and students have secure access through FU Account single sign-on, and use is free for FU members until further notice; OpenAI models are hosted through Microsoft Azure in European data centres and open-weight models through GWDG/KISSKI.
